deepseek.reason: Response 2 provides a more robust plan with two mandatory sign-offs (including one before procurement to lock capital expenditure), explicitly ties the stop/pivot triggers to the go-live window and ROI timeline, and directly addresses the carbon credit uncertainty in the ROI model, reducing the need for follow-up questions.

Response 1 provides a more precise and decision-ready plan with clearly defined mandatory sign-offs before procurement and full deployment, a sharper focus on the critical grid interconnection risk, and a stop/pivot trigger tied to the go-live window rather than a vague shipping season.
